PARISROC is the first ASIC that allows the acquisition of a photomultipliers (PMT) array in triggerless mode, without dead-time, with a good time resolution and with a good linealization of the charge measurement.
PARISROC is an innovative ASIC for the readout of photodetectors arrays.
the PARISROC ASIC is a complete readout chip for photomultiplier arrays, with variable gain, and that it allows triggerless acquisition.

the development of a new generation of photomultiplier readout chips for large area photodetectors.
the development of a new generation of photodetector array readout chips for the next generation of neutrino detectors.

the design of an integrated circuit that is able to provide the necessary signal conditioning and digitization of the signals coming from the photomultipliers (PMs) used in the neutrino experiments, and to transmit the data to a computer.

we designed and tested an integrated read out ASIC for 16 independent channels, each one able to perform a charge and time measurement.
we designed, simulated and tested a 16 channel ASIC, which integrates the front-end electronics for the PMTs.
